"""Saved driver for the HumanoidBench door task."""
from rcb_client import Robot
import argparse, json
import numpy as np

RANGES = np.asarray([
    [-.43,.43],[-.43,.43],[-3.14,2.53],[-.26,2.05],[-.87,.52],
    [-.43,.43],[-.43,.43],[-3.14,2.53],[-.26,2.05],[-.87,.52],

    [-2.87,2.87],[-3.11,.34],[-4.45,1.3],[-1.25,2.61]])

def rad_to_action(q):
    q = np.asarray(q)
    return 2 * (q - RANGES[:,0]) / (RANGES[:,1]-RANGES[:,0]) - 1

def joint_action(index, angle):
    lo, hi = RANGES[index]
    return 2 * (angle-lo)/(hi-lo)-1

def action_for_q(q):
    return np.clip(rad_to_action(q), -1, 1)

def ramp_and_hold(a0, at, ramp=15, hold=10):
    return np.vstack((np.linspace(a0,at,ramp,dtype=np.float32), np.repeat(at[None,:],hold,axis=0)))

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--reset',action='store_true')
    p.add_argument('--pitch',type=float,default=-.7)
    p.add_argument('--elbow',type=float,default=.25)
    p.add_argument('--steps',type=int,default=25)
    args=p.parse_args()
    r=Robot()
    if args.reset:
        r.reset(cameras=['room_camera','left_eye_camera','right_eye_camera'])
    print('status',json.dumps(r.status()))
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['room_camera','left_eye_camera','right_eye_camera'],video='none')
    q=np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:19])
    a0=action_for_q(q)
    at=a0.copy()
    at[15]=joint_action(15,args.pitch)
    at[16]=joint_action(16,0.)
    at[17]=joint_action(17,0.)
    at[18]=joint_action(18,args.elbow)
    n_ramp=max(5,args.steps//2)
    A=ramp_and_hold(a0,at,n_ramp,args.steps-n_ramp)
    res=r.submit('joint_position',A,dt=.02,interpolate='hold',cameras=['room_camera','right_eye_camera'],video='frames',video_fps=10,note='reach toward door handle')
    res.save('/app/output/latest')
    print('phase',json.dumps({'done':res.done,'meta':res.meta,'status':r.status()}))
